summary: 102B: 0x11C00000 mask path reads byte6 then bytes0..5. At eligible loop tail, first fresh word196 is unsigned-compared against R5; only lower values trigger a separate reload into R5 and R7=R9. Second independent word196 read compares against R6; only greater values trigger separate reload into R6 and R8=R9. All outcomes join BDEE. No value stability or monotonicity assumption.
